en_title: 'I'm Blown Away' — Hideo Kojima Can't Get Enough of Kane Parsons' Backrooms Movie
cn_title: 小岛秀夫盛赞Kane Parsons《后室》
subtitle: 怀旧与新奇
opus_summary: 小岛秀夫盛赞Kane Parsons执导的《后室》，称影片的迷宫式空间和多边形观感令他想起早期游戏开发。影片今年5月上映后广受好评并打破多项纪录，成功也为其他网络恐怖故事改编电影打开机会。

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima had high praise for Kane Parsons’ Backrooms, remarking on how the film reminded him of the maze-like maps and polygonal look of early video games.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫高度赞扬了Kane Parsons的《后室》，称这部电影让他想起早期电子游戏中迷宫般的地图与多边形画面风格。

paragraphs.en: 21-year-old Kane Parsons made a strong directorial debut with Backrooms, which released to critical acclaim and broke several records on release in May 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 21岁的Kane Parsons凭《后室》完成了强势的导演首秀。该片于2026年5月上映，收获好评，并在上映时打破多项纪录。

paragraphs.en: The liminal horror flick adapted the popular online creepypasta of the same name, which first surfaced on 4chan and has since spiraled into a community-driven initiative with multiple subgenres, video games, short films, and much more.
paragraphs.cn: 这部阈限恐怖（liminal horror）电影改编自同名热门网络恐怖故事（creepypasta）。该故事最早出现在4chan，后来发展为由社群推动的创作项目，衍生出多个子类型、电子游戏、短片等大量内容。

paragraphs.en: Famed game director and noted cinephile Hideo Kojima has now gotten around to watching it, and left a glowing review of the movie on his English social media account that gives readers some insight into what the early days of game development were like.
paragraphs.cn: 知名游戏导演、电影爱好者小岛秀夫如今也看了这部片，并在其英文社交媒体账号上留下盛赞影评，让读者得以一窥游戏开发早期的模样。

paragraphs.en: In his post, Kojima said he was “blown away” by the film and described Backrooms as “a world where nostalgia and novelty attack you in the form of ‘art,’” saying it reminds him of “pseudo-3D games from the 2D era, back in the dawn of RPGs and the Family Computer (NES), before polygons and textures existed.”
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫在帖文中称自己被这部电影「震撼到了」，并形容《后室》是「怀旧与新奇以『艺术』之形向你袭来的世界」。他表示，这让他想起「多边形和贴图尚未出现时，RPG与红白机（NES）刚起步的2D时代伪3D游戏」。

paragraphs.en: “Simulated 3D spaces built from looping, repetitive visuals: digital labyrinths unconstrained by the rules of architecture. I used to draw maps on graph paper just to keep track of where I was. That sense of confinement. That feeling of anxiety. Both are revived here in live action. The art direction is clever, incorporating elements of art, architecture, and psychology. This is a 21st-century liminal-space version of ‘CUBE,’ a work of surrealism and cubism in which video games of the 1980s and the modern world connect across dimensions.”
paragraphs.cn: 「由循环、重复的画面构成的模拟3D空间：不受建筑规则束缚的数字迷宫。过去我会在方格纸上画地图，只为弄清自己身在何处。那种受困感，那种焦虑感，都在这里以真人形式重现。美术指导很巧妙，融入了艺术、建筑与心理学元素。这是21世纪阈限空间版的《异次元杀阵》，一部融合超现实主义与立体主义的作品；1980年代的电子游戏与现代世界在其中跨维度相连。」

paragraphs.en: Kojima’s reaction to Backrooms has spawned no end of both jokes and heartfelt responses from fans, with one writing, “I think you and Kane Parsons would have a lot to talk about.”
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫对《后室》的反应引发了粉丝层出不穷的玩笑与真挚回应。一位粉丝写道：「我觉得你和Kane Parsons会有很多话可聊。」

paragraphs.en: “You know what you must do: scan Kane Parsons,” another joked, referencing Kojima’s penchant for scanning actors into his games like Death Stranding and the upcoming OD .
paragraphs.cn: 另一位粉丝开玩笑说：「你知道自己该做什么：扫描Kane Parsons。」这指的是小岛秀夫喜欢将演员扫描进《死亡搁浅》和即将推出的OD等游戏。

paragraphs.en: Thus far, Parsons hasn’t responded to Kojima’s comments on Backrooms. However, he recently spoke out after fans reported that their artwork was getting copy striked on behalf of A24 on platforms like RedBubble. Parsons spoke with the studio and the strikes were released , saying A24 has “been insistent since day one on keeping the community protected, as it always has been.”
paragraphs.cn: 截至目前，Parsons尚未回应小岛秀夫对《后室》的评论。不过，粉丝报告称自己的作品在RedBubble等平台收到以A24名义提出的版权投诉后，他最近对此发声。Parsons与该工作室沟通后，这些投诉已被撤销；他称A24「从第一天起就坚持保护社群，一如既往」。

paragraphs.en: Backrooms’ success has also opened doors for other creepypasta-inspired films, with movies for Siren Head, Cartoon Cat, and the Mandela Catalogue getting greenlit.
paragraphs.cn: 《后室》的成功也为其他受网络恐怖故事启发的电影打开了机会，Siren Head、Cartoon Cat和The Mandela Catalogue的电影项目均已获准立项。
